cover.title: don't sign up until it earns it

slides.title: start with proof
slides.body: use the three free no-sign-up downloads to generate real graphics before giving away your email or committing to another tool

slides.title: test the output
slides.body: check whether the design actually looks polished, keeps your message readable, and works across the formats you publish most

slides.title: watch your time
slides.body: a useful test should show finished branded graphics quickly, not leave you rebuilding layouts and resizing every version yourself

end.title: then decide
end.subtitle: if the downloads make your workflow easier and the results look publishable, creating an account becomes a choice based on evidence
